metadata.title: Retro Summer Camp Comedy Poster Layout

recipe.visualDefinition: A central group of illustrated characters in 1970s summer attire gathered around a wooden fence, set against a soft-focus lake background within a circular vignette, topped by bold, overlapping red block lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Central male figure as the vertical axis for the character cluster
Large-scale title overlapping the top of the character vignette
Horizontal wooden fence rails providing structural grounding
High-contrast red title against a clean white negative space
coreInvariants: Circular vignette framing for the background scene
Heavy black outlines on the primary title lettering
Warm, sun-drenched lighting on illustrated skin tones
Primary color palette dominated by red, blue, and tan

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Characters are centered vertically and horizontally, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red title at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold title, move down to the central male face, then radiate outward to the surrounding female and child characters.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space at the top and bottom margins creates a clean, focused look.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blue and Tan (Clothing and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the title; medium saturation and warm values in the central illustration.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are tightly kerned and overlapping
The 'T' is oversized and acts as a central pillar
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'S' have sharp, flared terminals

composition.relationshipToImage: overlaps the top of the illustration

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold custom display type paired with clean, functional grotesque sans-serif for credits.

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure for the title skeleton.
Appropriate for the secondary metadata and credits.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1970s style gouache illustration of a group of young adults in summer camp attire (t-shirts, shorts, bikinis) leaning on a rustic wooden fence. In the background, a soft-focus lake and cabins are visible within a circular vignette. The lighting should be warm and sunny. Leave the top 25% and bottom 10% of the canvas as solid white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, red custom-lettered title in all caps across the top center, overlapping the illustration slightly. The letters should have a thick black outline and overlap each other. Add small black sans-serif credit text at the very top and bottom margins.

verificationChecks: Illustration has a hand-painted gouache texture
Central 'T' in title is larger than other letters
Background is contained within a soft circular vignette

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the title (e.g., orange instead of red)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red title is the most vibrant element
Check that the fence provides a clear horizontal line
Verify the white space at the top is sufficient for credits
Confirm the illustration style looks like traditional media
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central ensemble gouache illustration with a circular vignette background, anchored by a heavy, overlapping, outlined red display title at the top.
